english.note: Use this all-purpose verb when liquid splashes or is splashed onto a person or surface.
This is the all-purpose choice for drops splashing or spattering, without stressing a deliberate cause or a particular target.

examples.english: Be careful—the wet road may splash you when cars go past.
examples.traditional: 小心啲，地下濕滑，車經過會濺到你。
examples.jyutping: siu2 sam1 di1 dei6 haa6 sap1 waat6 ce1 ging1 gwo3 wui5 zin3 dou3 nei5

examples.english: The water can splatter everywhere when I wash the car.
examples.traditional: 洗車嗰陣啲水濺到成身都係。
examples.jyutping: sai2 ce1 go2 zan6 di1 seoi2 zin3 dou3 seng4 san1 dou1 hai6
